title: What is the maximum detection distance of the VL53L7CX for a black object?
content:
Hi,

I am using the VL53L7CX in an object detection system.

Today, I found that the sensor does not detect black objects well. It can only detect a black object at a very short distance, approximately 10 cm.

Is this the expected behavior?

If so, what is the maximum detection distance of the VL53L8CX for a black object?

My application requires the sensor to reliably detect a black object at a distance of about 50 cm.

Is there any way to improve the detection performance for black objects, such as changing the configuration or tuning any parameters?

Thank you.
